scope: Expanded Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Asia regional macro-risk text-news coverage and major-news scoring.
checks: Asia macro-risk channel is isolated from existing publishers
Text-news search covers yen, BOJ, JGBs, Japanese bankruptcies, won, BOK, China property/local debt and Asian capital outflows
Video, interview, livestream and YouTube sources are excluded from the new channel
Google News is used only for discovery and attempts to resolve to the original publisher article
Asia stress and cross-border transmission signals increase major-news scoring
News page includes a Japan/Asia risk filter
Home and news major-card scoring use the same regional-risk logic
Traditional Chinese readability and invalid-page filters remain enabled
Service worker, seed files and isolated GitHub Actions branch are included
limitations: Google News may occasionally retain an article-specific aggregator URL when the original publisher blocks redirect resolution.
The channel discovers public Traditional Chinese text articles; it does not ingest television interviews, talk shows or video transcripts.
External publishers can change RSS/HTML behavior. Last-good archives are preserved when the fresh batch is insufficient.
test_summary: 58 automated tests passed, plus Python compilation, JavaScript syntax, JSON/YAML parsing, smoke test and HTML local-reference validation. 24 GitHub Actions workflows included.
